timeline.note: Same-node steady-clock interval unions on the read's worker TID. Observed overlaps are lower bounds when sampled, toggled, truncated or dropped. Client identity joins use port and sequential request ID; ambiguous port reuse is excluded. No cross-host clock subtraction or attribution of follower I/O, scheduling or network delay.

note: Three correlated off/on windows per group. Same-process default-adaptive observation; load shares Follower 3. Percentiles are medians of window percentiles, not pooled percentiles. Leader-thread overlap is request-weighted wall time, not device latency or system utilization; excludes follower I/O and uninstrumented phases.
